name: /help
desc: Show keys and commands

name: /new
desc: Start a new session: clear the screen and the conversation the team is told (the history stays in the mission)

name: /export
desc: Save this session as a markdown document in the mission; `all` saves every session of the mission

name: /context
desc: What the next task is told of this conversation: how much, how trimmed, at what trust (`full` shows the text)

name: /search
desc: Search the knowledge base (also ctrl+k); enter puts @path in the prompt

name: /sources
desc: Where the answers came from: files read and documents cited (also ctrl+s)

name: /pin
desc: Keep the last reply, or the text you give, in the mission notebook

name: /notes
desc: Read the mission notebook

name: /xenia
desc: The org store: its health, and the steward's approval card (the exact bytes to be signed; nothing is signed until you type the card's code back)

name: /org
desc: The organization's bundles, goals, perspectives and open items; add, update or remove a bundle (no approval: your key is the decision)

name: /connectors
desc: Which connectors are configured, logged in and pinned

name: /mouse
desc: Turn mouse reporting on or off (off hands text selection back to the terminal; on, drag to select and copy)

name: /quit
desc: Leave the console; the daemon keeps running

name: /build
desc: A Builder task: worktree, tests, audit, then your approval to merge. --optimistic decides its worktree edits itself, records each, and blocks the merge until you have reviewed them all

name: /council
desc: A blind three-round Council (architect, strategist, red-team) that ends in a decision and next steps (/follow starts them); --tier raises every seat (never lowers); --lenses gives each seat one of your bundles' perspectives; you decide if it deadlocks

name: /distill
desc: The writer drafts knowledge files for an org bundle from allow-listed sources (team context and specs, mission decisions and Council verdicts) into a staging directory of this mission; nothing is written into a bundle

name: /follow
desc: Start the next steps of the last Council's verdict, one after the other; a Council that asked you to choose needs the option's number

name: /settings
desc: What each role starts on and what is waiting for your yes; change a setting here or just ask for it

name: /reduce-motion
desc: Accessibility: stop every animation (badge blinks, spinners, faces, pulses); no argument flips it, or just ask for it

name: /pictures
desc: How pictures in the reader are drawn: quadrant blocks (sharper, the default) or half blocks (if your font draws quadrants badly); for this session, DELPHI_PICTURE sets it for good

name: /pace
desc: For now, spread work over your providers for fastest progress (sprint) or token efficiency (frugal); no model is ever lowered to do it, and it resets when the daemon stops

name: /timer
desc: Wake a role later: /timer 20m check CI · /timer @architect 1h review · /timer list · /timer cancel <id>

name: /models
desc: The model pool: which models are usable, out of quota, or cooling down

name: /agents
desc: Every agent running now and what it is doing

name: /observe
desc: The narrator, the read-only live window: opens in a new tmux window or terminal window

name: /usage
desc: Tokens and spend by role, task, model or mission

name: /budget
desc: Show or change this mission's cost ceiling

name: /permissions
desc: Approval mode (Shift+Tab cycles it)

name: /decisions
desc: Review an optimistic build's provisional decisions (/decisions ratify all-routine)

name: /merge
desc: Run the gates and the merge card again for a kept branch, after review

name: /retro
desc: Rules the Orchestrator proposed: review, accept or reject; `run` asks it to look at this mission now

name: /ratify
desc: Pending proposals (config, manifests, specs): review and approve

name: /resume
desc: After a restart: continue the tasks it interrupted

name: /pause
desc: After a restart: leave the interrupted tasks as they are

name: /mission
desc: The current mission

name: /missions
desc: This workspace's missions, newest first; reopen one with delphi chat --mission <id>

name: /more
desc: The rest of the last reply, when it was shortened

name: /y
desc: Approve the waiting card once

name: /a
desc: Approve similar actions this task (Amber only)

name: /n
desc: Reject the waiting card

name: /d
desc: View the waiting card's full payload
